# Three Village Local

> Three Village Local (threevillagelocal.com) is the free local guide to Setauket, East Setauket, Stony Brook, Port Jefferson and the rest of the Three Village area on the North Shore of Long Island, New York. It lists local businesses, this week's events, restaurant specials, homes for sale and community stories, and is updated every day.

Three Village Local is run locally and is free for residents to use. Businesses can add a free listing or a paid featured listing. Event details come from the organizers (libraries, historical societies, chambers of commerce, village groups); always confirm times with the organizer before you go.

## Quick answers (rebuilt every day)

- [Things to do this weekend in Stony Brook, Setauket & Port Jefferson](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/this-weekend): every event this Friday to Sunday with time, place and a link, plus the rest of the week
- [Restaurant specials & happy hours this week](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/restaurant-specials): current specials from local restaurants and bars, checked every morning
- [Restaurants in Stony Brook, NY](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/restaurants-stony-brook): where to eat, with cuisine, address, phone and local favorites
- [Restaurants in Setauket & East Setauket, NY](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/restaurants-setauket)
- [Restaurants in Port Jefferson, NY](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/restaurants-port-jefferson)
- [What's new in Three Village](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/whats-new): new local businesses, the latest local stories and what's coming up
- [Halloween in Three Village](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/halloween): Halloween 2026 events, trick-or-treating, haunted happenings and fall fun near Setauket, Stony Brook and Port Jefferson
- [Restaurants in Stony Brook](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/restaurants-stony-brook): where to eat in Stony Brook, NY
- [Restaurants in Setauket and East Setauket](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/restaurants-setauket): where to eat in Setauket, NY
- [Restaurants in Port Jefferson](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/restaurants-port-jefferson): where to eat in Port Jefferson, NY

## Main pages

- [Home: what's happening now](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/): today's events, top things to do this week, restaurant specials, local weather and news
- [Find a local business](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/categories): every listed business, grouped by category (restaurants, home services, health, attorneys, real estate, shops and more)
- [Restaurants](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/restaurant): restaurants, cafes and bars in the Three Village area
- [Events](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/events): upcoming local events, each with date, time, place and organizer
- [Events calendar](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/events-calendar): the same events in a month view
- [Local stories](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/blog): event guides, business spotlights and community news
- [Homes for sale this week](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/locallistings): new real estate listings in Setauket, Stony Brook and nearby, updated every Friday
- [Three Village Farmers & Artisans Market](https://www.threevillagelocal.com/three-village-farmers-market): dates, hours and location
